annotations.title: Is it safe to go? US State Dept + UK FCDO travel advice for one country (live)

description: Use for safety / duty-of-care screening of one destination: US advisory level 1-4 with summary, dates and link, UK FCDO alert status (advice against all / all-but-essential travel to all or parts), latest change, warnings and the entry-requirements excerpt, plus a combined headline. Optional: country. PAID: $0.040 per call, no API key or account, or free with a Trip Desk Pass. Pay with x402 over MCP (USDC on Base) or MPP over MCP (USDC.e on Tempo); an unpaid call returns the payment terms and charges nothing. Bad input is rejected before any payment; failed work is never charged. Same data as GET /v1/advisory.

country.description: Destination: ISO alpha-2/alpha-3 or English name. Default (bare call): TH

pass.description: Optional Trip Desk Pass token (tp1....). With a valid pass this call is not charged. Prefer setting it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>.
